title: The small Davenport constant of the Heisenberg group of order 125
summary: The small Davenport constant $\mathsf{d}(G)$ of a finite group $G$ is the maximal length of a product-one-free sequence over $G$. For the exponent-$p$ Heisenberg group $H_{p^3}$ of order $p^3$, Godara and Sarkar proved $\mathsf{d}(H_{27})=6$ and posed $\mathsf{d}(H_{p^3})=3p-3$ for every odd prime $p$, leaving $p\ge5$ open. We settle the first open case: $\mathsf{d}(H_{125})=12$. The lower bound is the explicit product-one-free sequence $x^4y^4v^4$. For the upper bound we record a product-one criterion that reduces the non-commutative problem to additive combinatorics over $\mathbb{F}_5^2$,…
